Definition: to be firm; hence, to speak surely
BiblicalUsage: yᵉtsab is the Bible's word for to be certain, to speak surely. In Daniel 7:19, I would know the truth of the fourth beast.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe yᵉtsab still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
